description: This file implements the LocalizedStrings class for managing localized string resources, including loading CSV files based on language codes, and retrieving localized strings with fallback options.

classes.name: LocalizedStrings
classes.description: A class for managing localized strings loaded from CSV files based on language codes.

methods.name: LocalizedStrings::LocalizedStrings
methods.description: Constructor that loads localized strings for a given language, with fallback to a generic language if needed.

methods.name: LocalizedStrings::GetString
methods.description: Retrieves a localized string by ID, with a fallback if not found.

methods.name: LocalizedStrings::GetMatchType
methods.description: Returns the match type indicating how the language was matched.

methods.name: LocalizedStrings::LoadStrings
methods.description: Loads strings from a CSV file corresponding to the specified language.

methods.name: LocalizedStrings::LoadSingleString
methods.description: Parses a single key/value pair from a line in the CSV file.
